properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 FleetAndSpot activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "CancelSpotFleetRequests", "Delete", "Spot Fleet Request",
    "CancelSpotInstanceRequests", "Delete", "Spot Instance Request",
    "CreateFleet", "Create", "EC2 Fleet",
    "CreateSpotDatafeedSubscription", "Create", "Spot Datafeed Subscription",
    "DeleteFleets", "Delete", "EC2 Fleet Request",
    "DeleteSpotDatafeedSubscription", "Delete", "Spot Datafeed Subscription",
    "DescribeFleetHistory", "Read", "EC2 Fleet",
    "DescribeFleetInstances", "Read", "EC2 Fleet",
    "DescribeFleets", "Read", "EC2 Fleet",
    "DescribeSpotDatafeedSubscription", "Read", "Spot Datafeed Subscription",
    "DescribeSpotFleetInstances", "Read", "Spot Fleet",
    "DescribeSpotFleetRequestHistory", "Read", "Spot Fleet",
    "DescribeSpotFleetRequests", "Read", "Spot Fleet",
    "DescribeSpotInstanceRequests", "Read", "Spot Instance",
    "DescribeSpotPriceHistory", "Read", "Spot Price History",
    "GetSpotPlacementScores", "Read", "Spot Placement Score",
    "ModifyFleet", "Set", "EC2 Fleet",
    "ModifySpotFleetRequest", "Set", "Spot Fleet Request",
    "RequestSpotFleet", "Create", "Spot Fleet Request",
    "RequestSpotInstances", "Create", "Spot Instance"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "CancelSpotFleetRequests", ResponseElements.successfulFleetRequestSet,
      EventName in ("CancelSpotInstanceRequests", "RequestSpotInstances"),
        ResponseElements.spotInstanceRequestSet,
      EventName == "CreateFleet", ResponseElements.fleetInstanceSet,
      EventName == "CreateSpotDatafeedSubscription", ResponseElements.spotDatafeedSubscription,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("CancelSpotFleetRequests", "DescribeSpotFleetInstances", "DescribeSpotFleetRequestHistory",
        "DescribeSpotFleetRequests", "ModifySpotFleetRequest"), RequestParameters.SpotFleetRequestId,
      EventName in ("CancelSpotInstanceRequests", "DescribeSpotInstanceRequests"),
        RequestParameters.SpotInstanceRequestId,
      EventName in ("CreateFleet", "DescribeFleetHistory", "DescribeFleetInstances"), ResponseElements.fleetId,
      EventName == "CreateSpotDatafeedSubscription",
        ResponseElements.spotDatafeedSubscription.spotDatafeedSubscriptionId,
      EventName in ("DeleteFleets", "DescribeFleets", "ModifyFleet"), RequestParameters.FleetId,
      EventName == "DescribeSpotDatafeedSubscription", ResponseElements.spotDatafeedSubscription.ownerId,
      EventName == "RequestSpotFleet", ResponseElements.spotFleetRequestId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
